EX-99.1 2 qcom092726erex991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEQualcomm Contact:Brett SimpsonSenior Vice President, Investor RelationsPhone: 1-858-658-4813 | e-mail: ir@qualcomm.comQualcomm Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 ResultsFiscal 2026 GAAP Revenues: $43.1 billionFiscal 2026 GAAP EPS: $12.70, Non-GAAP EPS: $10.54—Renewed Long-term QTL License Agreements with Apple, Huawei and Transsion——Announced Multi-Generational Product Collaboration with Amazon for AI Data Centers——Record QCT Automotive Revenues: Achieved First $2B Quarter, Growing 89% Year-Over-Year—SAN DIEGO - November 4, 2026 - Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ: QCOM) today announced results for its fiscal fourth quarter and year ended September 27, 2026. “We are pleased to deliver fourth quarter non-GAAP revenues at the high end of our guidance, along with 36% year-over-year growth in combined QCT Automotive and IoT revenues,” said Cristiano Amon, President and CEO of Qualcomm Incorporated. “Fiscal 2027 marks the start of our non-handset revenue inflection, including the ramp of our Data Center business. Non-handset revenues are projected to grow by more than 60% year-over-year, and we are reiterating our fiscal 2027 Data Center revenue target of $5B.”Fourth Quarter Results1 GAAP Non-GAAP (in millions, except per share data and percentages) Q4 Fiscal 2026 Q4 Fiscal 2025 Change Q4 Fiscal 2026 Q4 Fiscal 2025 Change Revenues $10,322 $11,270 (8%) $10,442 $11,270 (7%) Earnings before taxes (EBT) $1,173 $2,971 (61%) $2,666 $3,792 (30%) Net income $1,251 ($3,117) +140% $2,332 $3,257 (28%) Diluted earnings (loss) per share (EPS) $1.17 ($2.89) +140% $2.17 $3.00 (28%) Fiscal 2026 Results1,2 GAAP Non-GAAP (in millions, except per share data and percentages) Fiscal 2026 Fiscal 2025 Change Fiscal 2026 Fiscal 2025 Change Revenues $43,120 $44,284 (3%) $43,240 $44,141 (2%) EBT $9,414 $12,663 (26%) $12,976 $15,458 (16%) Net income $13,628 $5,541 +146% $11,311 $13,298 (15%) EPS $12.70 $5.01 +153% $10.54 $12.03 (12%) (1) Discussion regarding our use of Non-GAAP financial measures and reconciliations between GAAP and Non-GAAP results are included at the end of this news release in the sections labeled “Note Regarding Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures” and “Reconciliations of GAAP Results to Non-GAAP Results.”(2) Fiscal 2026 GAAP results included a $5.7 billion income tax benefit, or $5.32 per share, resulting from the release of a valuation allowance that was established in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025. The “Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements” in this news release provides a description of certain risks that we face, and our most recent annual report on file with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) provides a more complete description of our risks.The semiconductor industry is experiencing a broad-based increase in input costs across wafer fabrication, assembly, test, advanced packaging, memory and other materials. As previously disclosed, we are taking actions to reflect the higher input costs in our product pricing. We anticipate the full benefit of these actions to be reflected in QCT gross margins in the second half of fiscal 2027.
